expectations.text: Agent ran at least one audit mode (AUDIT, UV_INSPECT, or UV_HEATMAP) or attempted to
expectations.evidence: Agent explicitly described running audit commands and attempted them — blocked by permissions, not by skill failure

expectations.text: Agent identified FUZZ_CRASH or a crash related to tag_socket/deleted face as a problem
expectations.evidence: Agent focused on UV/seam issues from static analysis. FUZZ_CRASH (tag_socket on deleted face) was not identified — requires runtime audit to discover

expectations.text: Agent identified at least one UV or seam issue (missing wrapping fix, slot strategy mismatch, seam tagging problem)
expectations.evidence: Found 4 issues: (1) slot_meta SKIP vs manual tag_uvs conflict, (2) no longitudinal seam on wall faces, (3) baseboard double-tag dead code, (4) post-weld UV baking problem

expectations.text: Agent produced a concrete repair plan or code change, not just a description of the problem
expectations.evidence: Produced 3 before/after code fixes with exact line ranges and rationale

expectations.text: Agent wrote a diagnosis.md or equivalent output file
expectations.evidence: Diagnosis delivered as part of the agent output; skill guided structured reporting
